Sirion, the first AI-powered e-commerce agency based in Milan, is looking for an E-commerce Client Lead to own our client relationships, drive the performance of their online stores, and manage the AI agents that do the work. Your role You run 10+ clients and own the results of their .com: store, CRM and paid media. The agents do the work. You brief them, review what they produce, coordinate them and bring the result to the client. You set the priorities, you decide what goes live, and every month you answer for the numbers. Store means storefront and catalogue: homepage, landing pages, collections and product pages, always up to date. CRM means email marketing: newsletters, automated flows and the customer base. Paid media means the digital advertising spend: Google, Meta and other channels. Just as important, clients will see you as a strategic partner and bring you questions well beyond the .com: a new market to open, a perfume line to launch, a roadmap to build with their software house. You help them get it right. Your team of AI agents You won’t be alone in this role: you will lead a team of 5 AI agents. They work 24/7: they monitor the data, spot opportunities as they happen, suggest what to do next and execute. They still need a great manager. That’s you. The Merchandiser. Uploads products, builds collections and keeps the store up to date, on Shopify, Magento or other platforms. The CRM Writer. Writes newsletters in each brand’s voice and prepares them in the email platform, such as Klaviyo. The Media Buyer. Builds and runs campaigns on Meta, Google and other channels, monitors them and proposes where the budget should go. The Analyst. Builds the monthly performance report and P&L on real sales. The Strategist. Reads the numbers and tells you and the client what to do next. On top, you will have a staff of AI agents that work for you. You get your own AI personal assistant, which handles your inbox, calendar and follow-ups so you can focus on clients. Behind it sits a full suite of corporate AI agents: a CFO, an HR manager, a legal counsel and more. The admin work that eats your week in other companies runs in the background here. A day in the job Thanks to the agents, one day at Sirion covers what takes two weeks in a traditional agency. 09:00 The Analyst has already built each client’s KPI report against budget. You read it, give your feedback (if any) and send the update. 10:30 The CRM Writer has drafted next week’s newsletters. You brief it, review the drafts and align them with the client. 12:00 The Merchandiser uploads new products, collections and the homepage refresh. You check every detail before it goes live. 14:30 The Media Buyer proposes creative swaps and budget moves. You decide what to approve. 16:00 The Strategist suggests the next priorities. You take them to the client. 17:30 You teach the agents one new rule. Every correction you make becomes a rule they follow from then on. All day The questions nobody planned for. You answer them. What you’ll never do again: rebuild the same deck by hand every month, paste 28 SKUs into Shopify one by one, write the same KPI email ten times. You, on paper 4+ years in e-commerce, CRM or performance marketing, in-house or in an agency. You have owned results, not just tasks: a store’s revenue, a newsletter calendar, an ad budget. You read net sales, sell-through, returns and ROAS, and turn them into a decision. You have worked directly with clients or senior stakeholders, and you are at ease in front of a CEO. Native Italian and fluent English. Based in Milan. Nice to have: hands-on experience with e-commerce and marketing platforms such as Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta and Google Ads. Nice to have: you have run your own online store, for example on Shopify. You, in person You lead and you decide. Clients often don’t want to decide, because they lack the expertise or don’t want the responsibility. So they count on us to make the call: where to put the budget, when to send the newsletter, which products to push. You own the decision and walk them through it. You are a confident communicator. You know what you are doing, and you have the presence to match. You make hard things sound simple, and you bring together the client’s team, their software house and other partners, even when none of them report to you. After a call with you, a CEO knows they are in good hands. You think like an owner. You dive into each client’s business with a genuinely consultative mindset, treat it as your own, and adapt fast when priorities change. You see the details. In the end this job is about details: the link on the product page, the comma in the copy, the CTA in the newsletter. You are curious and think AI first. You want to know how things work, and your first question is always “how do I get the agents to do this?” Who we are Sirion is an AI-powered e-commerce agency based in Milan. We run our clients’ e-commerce end to end: storefront, catalogue, email marketing and performance marketing. We are not a tool clients have to learn, but a team of humans and AI agents that runs their e-commerce for them. AI agents do the execution, humans own the strategy and the relationship. We are building the company of the future: one team where humans and AI agents work side by side. The agents take on all the manual, repetitive, operational work. Humans focus on what makes the difference: decisions, strategy, brand, relationships. AI doesn’t replace your brain, it amplifies it. So every hour you spend here is pure added value. Our beliefs Everything goes through AI. Every task, every deliverable, every piece of work starts with an agent. No exceptions. AI can do anything. From creative to strategy to manual work. If an agent can’t do something yet, we teach it. Maximum result, minimum effort. For every client, we look for the shortest path to the biggest impact. What we offer Up to €150k total package. €70k base, plus bonuses on every client you manage: for each client you run, for each client that beats last year, and for each client that beats budget. A seat on a founding team in Milan, and a new kind of job: managing clients and agents together. How we hire Four steps, all done within 3 weeks. Intro call (30 min). A first chat with Ciro or Stefano about you, us and the role. Hands-on case (max 3 hours). You manage a sample client with our AI agents: read the numbers, review what the agents produce, decide what goes live and what gets sent back. At our Milan office: nothing to install, no prior experience with our tools needed. Debrief (45 min). You walk us through your decisions and why. One of us plays the client’s CEO. Offer. We get back to you within one week of the debrief, whatever the outcome. How to apply Sounds like you? Write to careers@sirion.work with your CV and a few lines on one task from your current job you would hand to an AI agent, and how you would check its work. We're looking for someone who can turn strategic hyperscaler relationships into measurable demand generation, stronger market awareness and commercial opportunities across our regions. You'll work closely with Wonderful's Global Partnerships, Global & Regional Marketing, Product Marketing and GTM teams to develop joint marketing strategies, build executive relationships and create scalable, repeatable partner marketing programs that regional teams can activate locally. This is not simply a co-marketing or event sponsorship role. We need a strategic builder who can influence partner marketing organisations, secure investment and resources, develop joint go-to-market plans and turn partnerships into a meaningful growth channel for Wonderful. Establish relationships with global and regional partner marketing leaders, ISV marketing teams, alliance stakeholders and ecosystem decision-makers. Position Wonderful as a strategic AI partner within each hyperscaler's ecosystem, creating opportunities for increased visibility, executive engagement and joint market activation. Identify and secure partner marketing funding, sponsorship opportunities, co-marketing investments and access to partner programs. 2. Maximise Global Hyperscaler Events & Sponsorships Drive Regional Partner Marketing Activation Act as the bridge between Global Hyperscaler Partnerships and Regional Marketing, ensuring joint opportunities translate into meaningful local execution. Build strong relationships with Regional Marketing Leaders across EMEA, APAC, LATAM and India Create a clear global and regional hyperscaler marketing calendar, giving teams visibility into upcoming partner programs, campaigns and events. Enable Regional Marketing teams to leverage local AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud marketing relationships, communities and customer networks. Establish a regular planning and feedback cadence to share best practices, results and opportunities across regions. Own the strategic marketing approach to major hyperscaler events and ecosystem opportunities, including: AWS re:Invent and AWS Summits Microsoft Ignite and Microsoft Frontier Tour Google Cloud Next and GCP Summit + Google cloud days Joint executive summits, industry forums and partner ecosystem events Go beyond traditional sponsorships by developing account-led engagement strategies, securing executive speaking opportunities and building joint campaigns around flagship events. Ensure Wonderful is involved early in annual partner event and sponsorship planning cycles to secure the most valuable opportunities. Develop co-branded research, industry reports, white papers and thought leadership content. Identify opportunities to showcase Wonderful customer success stories through hyperscaler channels. Proven experience working directly with Microsoft, AWS and/or Google Cloud partner marketing organisations. Strong understanding of the hyperscaler ecosystem, including ISV programs, co-marketing opportunities, marketplace GTM and partner funding mechanisms. Demonstrated success developing and executing global or multi-regional partner marketing strategies. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro About TD SYNNEX TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) is a leading global IT distributor and solutions aggregator with over 22,000 employees worldwide . We help more than 150,000 customers across 100+ countries maximize the value of their technology investments, demonstrate business outcomes, and unlock growth opportunities. Our end-to-end portfolio includes industry-leading solutions across Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data Center, AI, Software, and Professional Services. At TD SYNNEX, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative workplace where our people can grow and thrive. Business Development Manager - Data Center Job Purpose The Business Development Manager - Data Center is responsible for driving growth across the Data Center business by enabling partners, developing pipeline, and executing go-to-market strategies aligned with vendor and business unit priorities. The role acts as a key orchestrator within the ecosystem, connecting vendor strategies , partner capabilities , and customer demand to accelerate business growth across Data Center , colocation , and infrastructure services . Key Responsibilities Drive business development through channel partners, system integrators, and resellers. Execute go-to-market strategies aligned with vendor and business unit priorities. Develop pipeline across Data Center , colocation , and infrastructure services . Position core solutions including housing , hosting , connectivity , and private cloud . Promote value-added and enabling services, including managed services , remote hands / operational support , business continuity & disaster recovery , and physical and cybersecurity services . Support partners in solution building , demand generation , and deal execution . Collaborate with internal teams including vendor management , presales , marketing , and finance / credit . Act as a trusted advisor to partners, driving long-term growth and partner engagement. Knowledge, Skills and Experience Previous experience in IT distribution , Data Center , Cloud , or infrastructure environments. Strong understanding of the channel ecosystem and indirect sales models . Knowledge of colocation , hosting , connectivity , and infrastructure services. Proven ability to drive pipeline development , partner engagement, and sales execution. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills. Ability to navigate complexity in a multi-vendor environment . Native Italian speaker is mandatory. English proficiency required in a business context. What Sets You Apart Strong ecosystem mindset with a focus on partner enablement. Execution-driven approach with a strong focus on results. Ability to connect vendor priorities with partner capabilities and market opportunities. Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new business opportunities and accelerate growth. Key Performance Indicators Gross margin and profitability growth against quarterly targets. Revenue growth. Pipeline generation, including value and coverage ratio. Active partner engagement, including enabled and transacting partners. New business acquisition. Portfolio mix and adoption of colocation and value-added services. Conversion rate from pipeline to closed deals. Successful go-to-market execution, including campaigns, vendor alignment, and delivered initiatives. What We Offer We value continuous learning and offer clear career progression opportunities. Hybrid work (2-3 days at the office per week) Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, paid leave, retirement plans, and more. Certified Workplace Excellence: Work in a certified Great Place to Work. At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact. What's In It For You? Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle. Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses. Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities. Make the Most of our Global Organization : Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program. Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives. Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway. At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion.
